recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core FHIR. If Occupational Data for Health is maintained in a separate IG or repository, review that external artifact only if it still publishes the obsolete retirementStatus.value model.
issue_request: FHIR-14739 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core OccupationalData and asked where OccupationalData.retirementStatus.value was, whether retirementDate alone was sufficient, and how retirement status related to employmentStatus.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentions FHIR-14739. The 2018Jan ballot page still showed OccupationalData.retirementStatus.value, while development commit 43bb1f0626 removed retirementStatus and the RetirementStatus value set and introduced OccupationalData.retirementDate. PHWG 2018-01 minutes explain that the retirementStatus LOINC code was actually for retirement dates and had been replaced by a retirement date element.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini comments OccupationalDataforHealth as pending -> Dropped, so source/occupationaldata is outside the current FHIR core build. The retained spreadsheet source contains employmentStatus and retirementDate, with no retirementStatus.value. FHIR-14479 later kept retirementDate independent of employer and did not reverse the retirementDate model.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because editing source/occupationaldata would affect a dropped, out-of-build artifact, and the retained source already reflects the historical retirementDate replacement.
